Mimic octopus

Mimic octopus The mimic octopus (""Thaumoctopus mimicus"") is an Indo-Pacific species of octopus capable of impersonating other local species. They are notable for being able to change their skin color and texture in order to blend in with their environment, such as algae-encrusted rock and nearby coral through pigment sacs known as chromatophores.
